narrationTexts: Found both bugs. Fixing them now.
finalText:
**Build's clean.** Exit 0, 8 warnings, 0 errors.

Two real bugs from the bump, both in the link stage:

1. `resolveRetries` in [options.js](src/core/options.js) read `options.retries`, but the bumped bundler now passes `retryCount`. Fixed the field name.
2. `isBackoffEnabled` in [retryPolicy.js](src/net/retryPolicy.js) threw on `undefined`, since the new config loader leaves unset flags undefined instead of `false`. Now treats `undefined` as disabled.

The rest was deprecation-warning noise from the bumped package, not actionable. Nothing left to do unless you want those deprecations addressed too.
